page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is a dedicated server instance designed for storage-heavy operations within the ecs.d1ne instance family. The system features 32 dedicated vCPUs based on Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz on an x86_64 architecture. System RAM is configured at 128.0 GB, supplying 4.0 GB of memory per core. Infrastructure connectivity includes a 20 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, operating on a KVM hypervisor platform.

A major defining characteristic of the ecs.d1ne.8xlarge hardware specification is its local storage configuration. The instance incorporates 94489 GB of local hard disk drive (HDD) capacity. This substantial local disk footprint supports dense storage deployment without mandatory dependence on network-attached block storage devices. The use of mechanical HDDs provides massive storage volume, though it introduces sequential and random access latency trade-offs compared to NVMe or solid-state storage setups.

From an operational perspective, the large local capacity allows high density per instance for storage-intensive tasks. The combination of 32 vCPUs, 128.0 GB memory, and 94489 GB local HDD capacity makes the instance suitable for distributed file systems, log analytics, offline data warehousing, continuous data ingestion, and batch processing pipelines.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is a storage-dense cloud server configured with 32 dedicated vCPUs driven by 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors on an x86_64 architecture. It provides 128.0 GB of system RAM, maintaining a 4.0 GB memory per core ratio, along with 20 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth running on KVM virtualization. The instance features a substantial integrated local HDD storage allocation of 94489 GB, eliminating the immediate requirement for external storage volumes. The high storage density per core yields efficient resource aggregation for datasets that do not strictly require SSD-level random read latency. However, workload deployment must account for mechanical HDD performance characteristics compared to solid-state alternatives. The server profile is optimized for high-volume data retention, bulk logging systems, distributed big data processing, offline analytics, and batch ETL pipelines requiring large local disk capacity.
